title: Room around the target
description: Current dots and expected intervals align around each row’s target, with a shared signed deviation scale.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, target, value, range } rows. All measurements must share one unit. Target and value are finite numbers or null; range is a complete finite ordered [low, high] pair or null. IDs must be unique and nonempty. Current value and expected range render independently after subtracting a valid target. Zero remains a true point or tick. No percentage normalization or confidence estimate is inferred.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading; defaults to Deviation from target.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned reporting or expected-range context.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats original targets, current values and expected bounds in tooltips. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: deltaFormatter
props.description: Formats signed deviations on the axis and in direct readings. The default includes a plus sign for positive deviations; direction does not imply success or failure.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
